candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.title: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A per
candidateAudit.text: In a world that is seemingly always connected, we lose ourselves in constant contact. As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Sich zusammen schreiben [to get in touch], A performance and poem by Carla Schwering and Timna Lugstein from by the department of Institute of Fine Arts & Media Art – Photography (Sophie Thun) The phrase "Schreiben wir uns zusammen" that on the surface means something like “let’s write to each other again in more detail” actually implies a postponement. In the performance, the artists type excerpts from their shared chat history in a poetic arrangement on two typewriters facing each other – messages in which they attempt to get closer to one another. The time and effort spent cancelling meet ups, for which there is supposedly no capacity is made visible. With the postcards created for the performance, visitors can reconnect with a long-lost friend. On the occasion of Angewandte Festival AIL hosts a selection of performances and installations in the cashier hall and the current exhibition will have more activations. We will give you an overview, step by step AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 Jul 2026, 15:30 Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) Performance by Leonard Otterbein leonard.ottb The audio performance Darf ich noch einen Satz? (Palimpsest for 8 speakers) explores how sound can model processes of memory formation and transformation. Layered oscillations and brief sound textures repeat with phase shifts, gradually overlapping and partially canceling each other out, much like the traces in an overwritten manuscript. The work is inspired by memory research on reconsolidation – in which recalling an event alters its stored form – and its cultural studies counterpart, reconstructivity. The piece is composed of multiple layers of sound that continuously overlap anew, attempting to cancel each other out in the process. In this process, however, the layers are never completely erased, so that fragments of the preceding states always remain Leonard Otterbein is a sound artist and composer with a background in ecology and ecotoxicology, where he studied mixture effects of agricultural pesticides and nanoparticles. His work spans instrumental and electroacoustic composition, examining perceptual thresholds. He works with psychoacoustic effects and approaches sound as spatial and sculptural material shaped by its relation to space. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsp
candidateAudit.text: From the project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness – a performance by mueller_divjak in front of Otto Wagner Postsparkasse as part of Angewandte Festival! 'LIMINAL TRACES. Celebrating Acoustic Ecologies' is a dynamic sound lecture that understands the acoustic world as a phenomenon of resonance, shaped by connectedness and interaction. Through the live-curated interplay of field recordings, physical and digital artefacts, the performance traces sonic imprints deeply embedded in our collective memory, presenting them as a new listening experience. Developed within SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS at the AIL, this solar performance explores the intersections of sound, pop history and solar energy, celebrating concept, improvisation and the (unexpected) emergent. The performance ends when the energy collected by the mobile solar unit runs out. — The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who conceived and initiated SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS, is working since 2023 at AIL with international artists and systems scientists to form experiential spaces by artistic means (scenographies) and to create sensory impressions that help us to better understand and resonate with living systems. During the project essential principles of living systems are transformed into olfactory, auditory and tactile artworks / artefacts and used experimentally. Team: Jeanette Müller, Paul Divjak, Alexandra Graupner, Anna-Maria Irgang

candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 3 July 2026, 15:00 Hypervigilant Performance by Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz iukumukui Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory artscience.ak Constant vigilance can develop as a response to racial discrimination and transgenerational trauma, allowing potential threats to be recognized in advance. This fight-or-flight state activates the nervous system and can lead to chronic muscle tension and bruxism. Teeth grinding occurs as a way of coping with stress during sleep, often driven by societal expectations to suppress fear or anger. Hypervigilant addresses this suppressed anger. Aluminum teeth suspended from the ceiling form a space similar to a cage that oscillates between protection and exposure. Shaped as gong-like instruments, the oversized representation of the artist’s bite is set into vibration during a sound performance to release embodied pressure and reduce tension in the nervous system. Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz’s practice centers on suppressed experiences expressed in imagined worlds. Through performative sculptures and installations, she examines spatial dynamics and power structures. Addressing socio-political themes such as racism, sexism, gender, and sexuality, she builds subconscious environments using reference-based objects and constructions in combination with text and sound. candidateAudit.text: As part of Angewandte Festival, AIL presents: Performance by Laura Oyuela and Ádám Salomvári (students of the department Cross-Disciplinary Strategies) Rocks, I mean; - Stars is a sonic and spatial performance departing from text, soundscapes, spoken words and its physical surrounding. The piece works with analogies between black holes and human beings through low frequencies, orbital motion, and stretched time, shaping a field that gathers bodies into one another. The project investigates how perceptual, cognitive, and affective dynamics shape the experience of artistic performance in relation to contemporary conditions of subjectivity, particularly isolation and hyperproductivity. The performance is part of the Cross-Disciplinary Strategies Master’s program exhibition 2026. The work is realised with the technical support of ÆSR Lab, which has contributed to its sonic and spatial development. Photo: earthboundeva

Following the Movement of Memory with master students from artscience.ak (free entry, no registrations needed): 25 June, 15:00 2 July, 17:00 3 July, 17:00 4 July, 17:00 9 July, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. [REVERBERATED] explores notions of memory as the annual exhibition of the master’s program Art & Science. The exhibition approaches this process through the metaphor of reverberation. Reverberation describes the reflection of sound from multiple surfaces, producing many overlapping echoes at once. Just as sound continues to resonate within a space, memories reverberate through bodies, media, and environments long after the events that created them. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Opening hours Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Angewandte Festival: 1 July (extended opening hours 11:00–21:00) 2 July (extended opening hours 11:00–21:00) 3 July (extended opening hours 11:00–21:00) 4 July (Open Saturday, opening hours: 11:00–18:00) AIL, Ott

candidateAudit.text: Ein neues Menü. Mitten im Sommer. ☀️ Wenn die Tage länger werden, verändert sich auch unsere Küche. Es wird frischer, leichter, lebendiger. Zitrus trifft auf Kräuter, Meer auf Gemüse, Säure auf Süße. Immer auf der Suche nach Balance. Thunfisch-Ceviche mit Yuzu und Avocado, Bottoncini mit Stracciatella, Garnelen und Kren, Tagliolini mit Fisolen, Basilikum, Pinienkernen und Zitrone. Daneben Gerichte, die Wärme und Tiefe mitbringen: Porchetta vom Perlhuhn, weißes Ragù, Cardoncelli-Pilze. Und natürlich darf auch der Sommer auf süße Weise enden. Mit Kirschen, Haselnüssen, Mandeln, Holunder und einem Hauch Nostalgie. Wie immer erzählen Acqua, Fuoco und Terra dieselbe Geschichte aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven. Saisonal. Essenziell. Mediterran. Materia · Wien

candidateAudit.text: Ein heißer Sommerabend in der Tigergasse. Eine lange Tafel, neue Gesichter, bekannte Freunde und die Freude, gemeinsam zu essen. Thunfisch-Tatar, Fisch, Pasta, Wein und viele Gespräche, die bis spät in den Abend hinein blieben. Genau so hatten wir uns den Auftakt des Sommers vorgestellt. Und obwohl das Meer an diesem Abend die Hauptrolle spielte, gab es am Ende einen unerwarteten Publikumsliebling: den Cannolo siciliano. Danke an alle, die mit uns den Abend genossen haben. Für die Neugier, die gute Stimmung und die gemeinsame Zeit am Tisch. Ein besonderes Dankeschön an panarum_austria für die schöne Zusammenarbeit. Der Sommer hat gerade erst begonnen. Materia · Wien

It's time for another Release!🌟 Eliecer Nuñez Osorio | Finca Mirador Apricot | Rosehip Tea | Panela Colombia Colombia | Washed imported via semillacoffee Don Eliecer Nuñez Osorio was born and raised in Ricabrisa, Tarqui, Huila, where coffee cultivation has long been part of everyday life. From an early age, he worked alongside his father on the family farm, learning the practical skills of coffee production through harvesting, weeding, and maintaining the fields. Although he completed primary school, he chose to dedicate himself to agriculture, seeing rural work as both a livelihood and a long-term project for his family. At eighteen, Don Eliecer began planting his own coffee plots, initially with Caturra before establishing his first thousand trees of the Colombia variety. This early success encouraged him to continue investing in coffee production. In 2005, an inheritance from his father allowed him to consolidate the land that would become his farm. Throughout this process, his wife, Ana Yeni Osorio Cruz, has been a constant partner in managing the farm and supporting their shared goals. In recent years, Don Eliecer has focused increasingly on specialty coffee, seeking to improve quality and create greater value from his work. Through relationships with producers and collaborators connected to Monkaaba, he began refining his production practices and exploring new opportunities for his coffee. candidateAudit.text: Final (for now) June Release!❤️‍🔥 Eleicer Guatin | El Jardin White Florals | Lemon | Black Tea Colombia Pink Bourbon | Washed imported via semillacoffee Don Eleicer Guatín Chito was born in the village of Los Pinos, where he spent his childhood working alongside his parents in the cultivation of corn, peas, beans, and later coffee. Daily life revolved around agricultural work, long walks to school, and household responsibilities that shaped his understanding of rural life from an early age. After his family relocated to La Argentina, he continued his education while helping his father on the farm, gradually developing a deeper connection to coffee cultivation. At twelve years old, Don Eleicer received a small plot of land from his father, an early sign of trust and responsibility. Following his military service, he returned to farming and invested his savings in coffee production. Together with his wife, he established a home and continued expanding his agricultural project. Over time, he became increasingly involved in specialty coffee, seeing it as an opportunity to create greater value and long-term sustainability for his family and farm. Today, Don Eleicer cultivates Pink Bourbon on Finca El Jardín in La Palmita, San Agustín, Huila. The 4.5-hectare farm sits at 1,980 meters above sea level, with two hectares dedicated to coffee. Ripe cherries are selectively harvested every three weeks, fermented for twelve hours before pulping, followed by a thirty-six-hour second fermentation and a drying period of fifteen to twenty days. candidateAudit.text: Next June Release! A really nice and comfy flavor profile - prefect daily driver😌 Ivan Junqueira Ribeiro | Fazenda do Cruzeiro Roasted Hazelnut | Dried Fruits | Milk Chocolate Brazil Yellow Catucai | Natural imported via cafeimportseurope This coffee comes from Fazenda do Cruzeiro, a large and historically rooted farm managed by Ivan Junqueira Ribeiro in Brazil’s Campo das Vertentes region. Established in 1923, the farm spans over 1000 hectares, with a significant portion dedicated to coffee cultivation across multiple varieties. It is part of the Sancoffee cooperative, which focuses on quality-driven production and building long term relationships between producers and international buyers. Within this scale, coffees like this are separated as “Farm Select” lots. These are traceable to a single farm and represent a step toward more differentiated quality in a context where production is often associated with volume. This approach allows producers to receive more direct value for quality while maintaining the efficiency that defines Brazilian coffee production. Harvesting combines manual and mechanical methods, with a focus on collecting ripe cherries. After harvest, the coffee is processed as a natural. Cherries are spread on patios or drying beds and left to dry intact for around 20 to 25 days, depending on weather conditions. During this time, the fruit slowly dries around the seed, and the coffee is regularly turned to ensure even drying and prevent defects. candidateAudit.text: This release is super special!🔥 Oscar Hernandez | Los Nogales Lavender | Lemon Verbena | Lime Colombia Orange Bourbon | Washed & Dried with Lavender imported via chicas_industry Oscar is a third-generation farmer who grows coffee in the south of the department of Huila, near the town of Bruselas. He is an energetic person, always positive and innovative, not only for his family but also for the wider environment. His father, Ricaurte Hernandez, was the first to prove what we know today: that the best coffees from all over Colombia can be found in Bruselas. In 2006, he won the Colombian Cup of Excellence and, as the locals say, spread the word. Ricaurte put Bruselas, and the entire department of Huila, on the map of fine coffee. Oscar continues this tradition, and thanks to him and his approach, Nogales is a centre of innovation and information for all the proactive farmers in the area. This coffee comes from the Yarumo lot at Finca Nogales, where Orange Bourbon is grown exclusively at the highest point of the farm. The variety has adapted to cooler conditions while still benefiting from strong sunlight due to its position. As one of the newer plantings, it is continuously observed and refined, with each harvest offering new insights into its potential. Production at Finca Nogales emphasizes careful selection and controlled processing. Harvesting is done manually, with pickers selecting only fully ripe cherries to preserve the integrity of the variety. candidateAudit.title: Ein neues Menü. Drei Wege, den Frühling zu schmecken. Bei Materia begleiten uns Acqua, Terra und Fuoco seit jeher, unsere drei Menüs rund um Fisch, Fleisch und vegetarische Küche.
candidateAudit.text: Ein neues Menü. Drei Wege, den Frühling zu schmecken. Bei Materia begleiten uns Acqua, Terra und Fuoco seit jeher, unsere drei Menüs rund um Fisch, Fleisch und vegetarische Küche. Mit der Saison verändern sie sich, wachsen weiter und erzählen immer neue Geschichten. Leicht und frisch mit Bernsteinmakrele, Gurke und Paprika-Kimchi. Warm und kraftvoll mit Tortelli alla Boscaiola oder Lamm mit Rosmarin. Grün und lebendig mit Ravioli alla Vignarola, Spargel, Erbsen und Pecorino. Drei unterschiedliche Stimmungen, getragen von denselben Werten: Produkt, Balance und Handwerk. Meer trifft Garten, Feuer trifft Kräuter, Tradition trifft neue Ideen. Ein Menü für alle, die sich gerne überraschen lassen – und den Geschmack der Saison suchen. Der Frühling ist angekommen. Wir servieren ihn ab jetzt in der Tigergasse. Materia · Wien

candidateAudit.text: 🍔🎬 Diner Giveaway Time! 🎬🍟 Lust auf einen richtig guten Abend? Wir verlosen gemeinsam mit Constantin Film 2x2 Kinotickets für den brandneuen Film NORMAL, der ab 16.4. in den Kinos zu sehen ist! 😍 Stell dir vor: erst ein saftiger Burger bei uns im Diner, dazu ein cremiger Milkshake… und danach gratis ins Kino – klingt nach dem perfekten Plan, oder? 😎 So kannst du teilnehmen: ✨ Folge uns gerne auf Instagram ✨ Like diesen Beitrag Mit etwas Glück schnappst du dir 2 Tickets für dich und deine Begleitung! 🎟️🎟️ Teilnahmeschluss ist 17.4.26 – also nicht lange überlegen! 🍀🎥🍿 Und worum gehts in dem Film?--> Eigentlich sollte die vorübergehende Versetzung in die verschlafene Kleinstadt Normal für Sheriff Ulysses (Bob Odenkirk) eine willkommene Auszeit von Eheproblemen und beruflichen Rückschlägen sein. Doch als ein misslungener Banküberfall die trügerische Ruhe der Stadt durcheinanderbringt, wird schnell klar, dass die Bewohner weit mehr zu verbergen haben, als zunächst angenommen. Ulysses merkt plötzlich: Diese Kleinstadt ist alles andere als „normal“...😮

candidateAudit.title: Happy International Women*s Day for everyone! Swipe right for more text in the images! If you find traces of patriarchy in your kitchen, it may be time for some spring cleaning! 🧹
candidateAudit.text: Happy International Women*s Day for everyone! Swipe right for more text in the images! If you find traces of patriarchy in your kitchen, it may be time for some spring cleaning! 🧹💜 because of recent developments and news across Europe, all the way to LA, but also discussions for the last few years about pubs and restaurants, bistros to high class fine dining in our wonderful Vienna, we feel compelled to take stand. As you can see, we didn't name these restaurants and bistros. It's not because it's a secret, it's all over the news and the internet. It's easy to find, and rightly so, read upon it, and make your own impression. For International Women's Day, and also in general, we find it important to talk about collective experiences, where the extreme abuse, sexism, homophobia, violence and harsh tone is just tip of the iceberg, the experiences chefs in gastronomy all over the world make, are too often too similar, even if "not as bad". It's tough enough to be anyone wanting to be a chef as a male. Being a women, or a migrant, or LGBTIQAN*, POC, neurodiverse, or a mixture of any of these, doesn't make it any easier either! On the plus side, it's being talk about, more and more, awareness and mental health as well as physical health are not ignored anymore everywhere, and good teams might be hard to find, but more and more existing! Tag your favourite Women* run places, your inclusive Chefs, send them these post, and encourage and support inclusive, healthy approaches to hospitality! #GastronomyReform #WorkCulture #TischVienna #FairKitchens #InternationalWomensDay #ViennaE

candidateAudit.text: 🌸Der Frühling steht vor der Tür und mit ihm ein Film der euch garantiert nicht kalt lässt. 🔥🎥 Am 12.März startet „GOOD LUCK, HAVE FUN, DON’T DIE“ in den Kinos – und weil Kino mit der richtigen Begleitung am schönsten ist, verlosen wir gemeinsam mit Constantin Film 2 x 2 Kinotickets an euch! 🍀 In GOOD LUCK, HAVE FUN, DON’T DIE betritt ein „Mann aus der Zukunft“ (Sam Rockwell) ein Diner in Los Angeles. candidateAudit.text: »Das große Theater von Oklahoma ruft euch! Es ruft nur heute, nur einmal! Wer jetzt die Gelegenheit versäumt, versäumt sie für immer! Wer an seine Zukunft denkt, gehört zu uns! candidateAudit.title: Endlich wieder offen! ✨ Ab Donnerstag, den 15. Jänner, sind wir wieder für euch da! Unser Betriebsurlaub, der große Jahresputz und die Vorbereitungen sind abgeschlossen – wir freue
candidateAudit.text: Endlich wieder offen! ✨ Ab Donnerstag, den 15. Jänner, sind wir wieder für euch da! Unser Betriebsurlaub, der große Jahresputz und die Vorbereitungen sind abgeschlossen – wir freuen uns riesig, euch endlich wiederzusehen. Wir waren in der Pause aber nicht untätig: Neben internen Teammeetings und Entwicklung, haben wir unser Reservierungssystem gewechselt. Was ist neu? * Wo buchen? Ihr findet uns vorübergehend zwar noch auf „The Fork“, aber Reservierungen sind ab sofort primär über unsere Website, den direkten Reservierungslink (wie in Bio), Google Maps sowie per E-Mail oder Telefon möglich. * Kreditkarte: Für unsere Fine Dining Tasting Menüs und den Brunch ist ab jetzt eine Kreditkarte zur Absicherung der Reservierung hinterlegt, mit eine kleinem Betrag. Sie wird aber nur dann in Anspruch genommen, wenn ihr, ohne es rechtzeitig abzusagen, nicht erscheint. * Warum? Leider hatten wir immer wieder „No-Shows“ (Gäste, die ohne Absage nicht erschienen sind). Um die Preise für alle fair zu halten und den hohen Aufwand in der Vorbereitung zu schützen, haben wir uns zu diesem Schritt entschieden. Wichtig: Solltet ihr keine Kreditkarte haben oder mit einem Sospeso bezahlen wollen, schreibt uns einfach eine E-Mail. Wir finden garantiert eine Lösung, damit ihr trotzdem bei uns genießen könnt! Gut zu wissen: Alle bestehenden Reservierungen, die vor dem Wechsel getätigt wurden, bleiben natürlich aufrecht. Falls ihr online Schwierigkeiten bei Änderungen oder Sonderwünschen habt, zögert nicht, uns direkt zu kontaktieren. Wir können es kaum erwarten, mit euch ins neue Jahr zu starten! 🥂✨

candidateAudit.text: Wir sind kurz mal Weg! ;) Betriebsurlaub: 24.12. – 06.01. ✨ Aber keine Sorge, wir sind bald wieder da! Vom 24.12. bis zum 06.01. machen wir unseren jährlichen Betriebsurlaub. candidateAudit.text: 🍸 NITRO SINGLETON FIZZ Recipe • The Singleton Single Malt Scotch Whisky • Timur Berry • Fresh lemon juice • Sugar syrup • Lustau Papirusa Sherry • Stracciatella Cheese cream • Smoked Peach Description: A silky, aromatic nitro fizz showcasing the soft, fruity character of The Singleton. Timur berry adds a gentle citrus-spice lift, while lemon brings vibrant brightness. Lustau Papirusa contributes depth and structure with its dry sherry notes. The cocktail is enriched with a creamy Stracciatella cheese cream, and finished with a smoked peach fizz for a delicate smoky-fruit finish and smooth mouthfeel. Inspiration Tradition meets modern technique. This cocktail was inspired by the desire to create drinks that usually take time and precision, even during the busiest hours. I wanted to explore a new technique that allows complex, labor-intensive cocktails to be enjoyed without compromise, even at rush hour, delivering both flavor and experience efficiently. candidateAudit.text: Gans was Besonderes, gans gemeinsam! Ganslessen mal anders: Exklusives Erlebnis! 🦢🌱 Gänsebraten in der Gruppe zum Genießen, ist eine wunderschöne Tradition. Wir sind der Meinung, dass dieses gemeinschaftliche Erlebnis für alle verfügbar sein sollte. Deshalb haben wir etwas Besonderes geschaffen, etwas das es so in Wien noch nie gegeben hat! Ab 17. Oktober laden wir euch jeden Freitag, Samstag, Sonntag und Montag zu unserem exklusiven Veganslbraten ein. Stellt euch vor: Ein großes, goldbraun gebratenes VeGansl, serviert im Ganzen für eure Gruppe von 6-14 Personen! Ab größere Gruppen gibt es 2 Braten zum Teilen. Dazu gibt es traditionelle Beilagen: Serviettenknödel, Bratensaft, Orangen-Apfel-Rotkraut, geröstete Maroni, Bratgemüse und Preiselbeeren. Ein Fest für alle Sinne! Unser Seitan-Gansl überzeugt mit knuspriger Haut, würzigem Seitanfleisch und einer saftigen Champignon-Maroni-Füllung. Vorspeisen und Nachspeisen könnt ihr spontan aus unsere Karte dazu aussuchen! Für € 31,90 pro Person könnt ihr dieses einzigartige Gruppenerlebnis genießen. Die Plätze sind streng limitiert, eine Reservierung ist notwendig. Das Angebot gilt vom 17. Oktober bis zum 8. Dezember, eine Verlängerung im Dezember ist auf Anfrage möglich. Wenn ihr nur zu zweit seid oder eine kleinere Runde plant, kommt ihr nicht zu kurz! candidateAudit.text: Unser norwegischer Skrei, auch bekannt als Kabeljau, besticht durch seine zarte Textur – ein Qualitätsmerkmal, das er den kalten, rauen Gewässern Norwegens verdankt. Durch eine besonders schonende Garung entfaltet der Fisch sein volles Aroma und sorgt für ein perfektes Geschmackserlebnis. Im HEAT servieren wir ihn mit einer intensiven Umami-Glasur aus Miso, auf einem Bett aus fein mariniertem, frischem Kohlrabi. Dazu gesellen sich knackiger, säuerlicher grüner Apfel und eine buttrige Dashi-Beurre-Blanc. Diese raffinierte Kombination begeistert mit vielschichtigen Aromen und spannenden Texturen. #heat #restaurant #grill #steak #steakhouse #vienna

candidateAudit.title: Kühlend und erfrischend: der Workshop “Limoncello-Lab” war am Hitzesonntag genau das Richtige! Limoncello selber machen plus Wissen rund um die Zitrone, Geschichte(n), sensoriales
candidateAudit.text: Kühlend und erfrischend: der Workshop “Limoncello-Lab” war am Hitzesonntag genau das Richtige! Limoncello selber machen plus Wissen rund um die Zitrone, Geschichte(n), sensoriales Geschmackstraining, Zubereitung, Rezepte und ein mediterranes Abendessen mit anschließender Verkostung einiger Limoncello-Varianten. Es war ein riesen Spaß! Nächster Termin voraussichtlich 22. September mit dem Workshop “Pasta Fresca”! Come passare in allegria la domenica più calda di giugno? Noi abbiamo indovinato tutto scegliendo la freschezza e il profumo con “Limoncello-Lab” Profumi e gusto! Impariamo le differenze tra i vari limoni con assaggi in comparazione -conoscere la qualità e difetti sensoriali, -preparazione e ricetta -curiosità e dettagli -come calcolare la gradazione alcolica -consigli d’uso -degustazione e storia di un liquore presente ovunque nel sud italia -piccolo menù abbinato e brindisi finale Prossimo appuntamento con una nuova esperienza sarà la domenica 22 settembre con il nuovo format di “Pasta-Lab” #citrus #citrusvienna #casacaria #limoncello #limoncellospritz🍋 #limoncellococktail #wienstagram #igerswien #zitrusliebe #im7ten insieme in un facile percorso per poter preparare e cucinare la pasta fatta a mano.

candidateAudit.title: Sumerian Head Amulet of a Goddess 2300-2100 B.C. Marble head amulet of a goddess worked out in high quality. The round head with pronounced cheekbones, a large, prominent nose and
candidateAudit.text: Sumerian Head Amulet of a Goddess 2300-2100 B.C. Marble head amulet of a goddess worked out in high quality. The round head with pronounced cheekbones, a large, prominent nose and a mouth shaped into a smile. The large eyes are pierced deeply into the stone and once held lapis lazuli inlays. The goddess has her hair parted in the middle, sideways long curls cascade over her temples. Behind them protruding bull ears which are typical for Sumerian head amulets. The head is vertically pierced for suspension. Sumerian head amulets are mainly known for male depictions and should personify heroes from the Gilgamesh epic such as Enkidu. Female portrayals like the present one are extremely rare. Possibly this amulet is a representation of Ningal, the goddess of reeds, wife of the moon god Nanna. See the marble head of Ningal from Ur, today in the Penn Museum in Philadelphia, USA, with the object number B16228. Mounted. Dimensions: 2.4 cm high Provenance: The Bactria Corp., New York, 1960 to 1970s. Thence Merrin Gallery, New York. Last in a New York private collection. Price: 8 000 Euro

candidateAudit.text: Large Old-Babylonian Cuneiform Barrel of Sin-Iddinam 1785-1778 B.C. Massive clay barrel from the period of the Old Babylonian king Sin-Iddinam from Larsa. The cuneiform barrel with a flat base and a circular opening on top depicts an inscription of around 70 lines covering the entire outside. Sin-Iddinam stresses that he dredged the river Tigris to provide water supply to his city. A series of similar barrels are known and published. The standard reference originates from Dougals Frayne "The Old Babylonian Period", 1990, pages 158-160, E4.2.9.2. Dimensions: 14.5 cm high Provenance: From an English private collection prior to 1992, thence on the English art market. Price: 12 000 Euro

candidateAudit.title: Clay human figurine (Fertility goddess) Tappeh Sarab, Kermanshah ca. 7000-6100 BCE, Neolithic period, National Museum of Iran. Ganj Dareh (Persian: o)J g aj; "Treasure Valley" in P
candidateAudit.text: Clay human figurine (Fertility goddess) Tappeh Sarab, Kermanshah ca. 7000-6100 BCE, Neolithic period, National Museum of Iran. Ganj Dareh (Persian: o)J g aj; "Treasure Valley" in Persian, or "Treasure Valley Hill" if tepe/tappeh (hill) is appended to the name) is a Neolithic settlement in the Iranian Kurdistan. First discovered in 1965, it was excavated by Canadian archaeologist, Philip Smith during the 1960s and 1970s, for four field seasons. The oldest settlement remains on the site date back to ca. 10,000 years ago, and have yielded the earliest evidence for goat domestication in the world. The only evidence for domesticated crops found at the site so far is the presence of two-row barley. At Ganj Dareh, two early ceramic traditions are evident. One is based on the use of clay for figurines and small geometric pieces like cones and disks. These are dated ca. 7300-6900 BC
